metrics_verification.counters: http_requests_total broken down by method, path, status (verified 200, 404, 500)

structured_logging_verification.sanitization: Inline credentials scrubbed to ://[REDACTED]@ and CRLF injection neutralized

error_logging_correlation.proof: Simulated 500 on /debug/simulate-error emitted both error-level exception log with stack trace and HTTP summary log sharing exact request_id req-500-drill

alert_completeness.actionability: Each alert contains PromQL expr, threshold, for-window, severity, summary, templated description, and runbook link

conceptual_answers.3am_triage_order: Alert notifies THAT an anomaly exists -> Dashboard/Metrics reveal WHAT is affected (endpoints, blast radius, onset time) -> Structured Logs correlated by request_id reveal WHY (exact error, stack trace, payload metadata).
conceptual_answers.monitoring_vs_observability: Monitoring tracks known-unknowns via predefined thresholds and dashboards. Observability provides high-cardinality structured context enabling engineers to ask novel questions about unknown-unknowns without deploying new instrumentation.
